title: No Dragon Egg
description: Disable dragon egg spawning with a simple, configurable Paper plugin
body:
# No Dragon Egg A tiny Paper plugin that prevents the Ender Dragon from spawning a dragon egg when it is defeated.
![Available for Paper](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/supported/paper_46h.png) ![Available for Purpur](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/supported/purpur_46h.png) ![Won't support Spigot](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/unsupported/spigot_46h.png)
## Features * Prevents the dragon egg from generating after the Ender Dragon dies. * Configurable. * Zero performance impact. * Plug-and-play. ## Configuration ```yaml # Enables or disables the plugin. enabled: true ``` Set `enabled` to `false` to restore vanilla behavior. ## Why? Perfect for servers that: * Want to prevent players from obtaining the dragon egg. * Reset the End regularly. * Use custom End progression or rewards. * Already have alternative ways to reward players. Simply install the plugin and you're ready to go. ## Requirements * Paper * Java 21+ ## **No Generative AI was used in the making of this plugin**
